name: my-claude-plugins
description: Personal fork of anthropics/claude-plugins-official with a patched telegram plugin (forward/reply attribution + text_link URL surfacing). Not Anthropic-managed.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram messaging bridge with built-in access control. Manage pairing, allowlists, and policy via /telegram:access.

plugins.name: telegram-durable
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code with a durable inbound store: every message is written to disk before it is handed to the session, and anything the session never received is replayed on the next start with a structured replay flag and the original timestamp — so a disconnected or restarting session does not silently drop what you sent. Also surfaces the sender's highlighted quote (message.quote) separately from the reply text, forward/reply attribution, text_link URLs, and ask_decision buttons for multiple-choice questions. Built-in access control via /telegram:access.
